verdict: Clean: the Sands' crown. Cleared with four stars and no fall, no console error, every spot reachable; the Heart of Noon (the Raid's boss, its own model, in the Sunken Heart) fell on the first try; the caravan, the rival (Zephyr), the trial and the gate (Bo) all played.

found.title: Props
found.text: The probe's “gap” is a gateway's lintel over its passage (meant); shrubs on the rim a few cm up; red rocks a little sunk.

found.title: Phone: the hero's passive box runs under the floor panel
found.text: On a phone, once the minimap shows, the box with the hero's badge and passive (Far Sight) is taller than what is in it and its frame runs behind the floor's panel (time, lives, shards). Every floor; small. The merge fixed the people's marks over the HUD and the map's names (pictures: after the merge). The fix would be in the Climb's HUD (src/tower/world/hud.ts): fit the box to its content, or step the floor panel down by the box's height while the minimap shows.
